pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark-colored polygons with sharp edge gradients. Geometry ranges from small, sub-rounded islands on the neck to larger, more elongated jagged forms on the shoulder and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light tan pathways. Junction nodes consist of tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. The pixel width of pathways is generally consistent across the visible flank, narrowing slightly at the anterior neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette of dark hair visible along the dorsal midline against the foliage background.
